21	/**
22	 * One intent at a time. Each tick it claims the next position to the server exactly like a client
23	 * would, so vanilla's own collision, gravity and setback checks decide whether the step happens.
24	 */
25	public final class WalkTask {
26	   private static final double STRIDE = 0.35;
27	   private static final int MAX_CHANGE = 1;
28	   private static final int TICK_LIMIT = 1200;
29	   private static final int STUCK_WINDOW = 20;
30	   private static final double STUCK_MIN_PROGRESS = 0.5;
31	   private static final int STUCK_LIMIT = 40;
32	   private static final int WEDGE_LIMIT = 12;
33	   private static final double CLOSE_LIMIT = 3.5;
34	   private static final int CLOSE_TICKS = 20;
35	   private static final int MAX_PATH_LENGTH = 60;
36	   @Nullable
37	   private static WalkTask current;
38	   private static int nextId = 1;
39	
40	   private final int id;
41	   private Path path;
42	   private final Vec3 target;
43	   private final double straightLine;
44	   private int ticks;
45	   private Vec3 checkpoint;
46	   private int checkpointTick;
47	   private int stuckTicks;
48	   private boolean repathed;
49	   private int refused;
50	   private int degraded;
51	   private int refusalStreak;
52	   private boolean closing;
53	   private int closeDeadline;
54	   @Nullable
55	   private String wedgeDetail;
56	
57	   private WalkTask(final int id, final Path path, final Vec3 target, final Vec3 from) {
58	      this.id = id;
59	      this.path = path;
60	      this.target = target;
61	      this.straightLine = planar(from, target);
62	   }
63	
64	   @Nullable
65	   public static WalkTask current() {
66	      return current;
67	   }
68	
69	   public static JsonObject start(final ServerLevel level, final Vec3 from, final Vec3 requestedTarget, final boolean snapToSurface) {
70	      JsonObject out = new JsonObject();
71	      if (current != null) {
72	         out.addProperty("accepted", false);
73	         out.addProperty("reason", "busy with task " + current.id);
74	         return out;
75	      }
76	      Vec3 target = snapToSurface ? surfaceSnapped(level, requestedTarget) : requestedTarget;
77	      Vec3 walkTarget = target;
78	      Path path = PathAdvisor.to(level, from, walkTarget, MAX_PATH_LENGTH);
79	      // One node means the only node is where we already stand: A* expanded no neighbour, so there is
80	      // no step to take. Accepting it would report a walk that finishes after two ticks.
81	      if (path == null || path.getNodeCount() <= 1) {
82	         out.addProperty("accepted", false);
83	         // Two different situations produced one reason, and the caller could not tell them apart:
84	         // "there is no route" and "there is nothing to walk, we are standing in the goal" are opposite
85	         // answers. The second one used to surface as a refusal, which made a perfectly reachable block
86	         // look undiggable whenever the agent was already next to it.
87	         out.addProperty("reason", BlockPos.containing(from).equals(BlockPos.containing(walkTarget))
88	               ? "already_at_target"
89	               : "pathfinder produced no route");
90	         return out;
91	      }
92	      WalkTask task = new WalkTask(nextId++, path, walkTarget, from);
93	      current = task;
94	      out.addProperty("accepted", true);
95	      out.addProperty("task_id", task.id);
96	      // canReach means "the exact target node was found"; vanilla's own navigation treats a false here
97	      // as "walk as far as the route allows", not as failure, so we report it instead of rejecting.
98	      out.addProperty("exact_target", path.canReach());
99	      out.addProperty("straight_line_blocks", Math.round(task.straightLine * 10.0) / 10.0);
100	      out.addProperty("est_ticks_lower_bound", (int)Math.ceil(task.straightLine / STRIDE));
101	      Mcbuddy.LOGGER.info(
102	            "[mcbuddy] walk task {} accepted: exact={} straight={} target={}",
103	            task.id,
104	            path.canReach(),
105	            Math.round(task.straightLine * 10.0) / 10.0,
106	            walkTarget
107	         );
108	      return out;
109	   }
110	
111	   public static void tick(final ServerPlayer agent) {
112	      WalkTask task = current;
113	      if (task == null) {
114	         return;
115	      }
116	      task.ticks++;
117	      Vec3 here = agent.position();
118	      // Arrival is the requested column at a standable height: x/z must be the requested block, and
119	      // the height within one step of the asked level, because a column's real stand height is the
120	      // world's (a plant under the feet is what restHeight finds, one above the model's guess). The
121	      // radius this replaced let the diagonal neighbour - 0.69 from a cell corner - count as arrived
122	      // without a single step, which measured as a reached that did not move.
123	      BlockPos feet = BlockPos.containing(here);
124	      BlockPos goal = BlockPos.containing(task.target);
125	      if (feet.getX() == goal.getX()
126	         && feet.getZ() == goal.getZ()
127	         && Math.abs(feet.getY() - goal.getY()) <= MAX_CHANGE) {
128	         finish(agent, task, "reached");
129	         return;
130	      }
131	      if (task.path.isDone()) {
132	         double remaining = planar(here, task.target);
133	         if (task.closing) {
134	            if (task.ticks > task.closeDeadline) {
135	               finish(agent, task, "stopped_short");
136	               return;
137	            }
138	         } else if (remaining <= CLOSE_LIMIT) {
139	            // The node list ends within a stride or two of the target, which is not the agent failing
140	            // to arrive. Walk the residual directly instead of reporting a near miss.
141	            task.closing = true;
142	            task.closeDeadline = task.ticks + CLOSE_TICKS;
143	         } else {
144	            finish(agent, task, "stopped_short");
145	            return;
146	         }
147	      }
148	      if (task.ticks > TICK_LIMIT) {
149	         finish(agent, task, "timeout");
150	         return;
151	      }
152	
153	      if (task.checkpoint == null || task.ticks - task.checkpointTick >= STUCK_WINDOW) {
154	         if (task.checkpoint != null && planar(here, task.checkpoint) < STUCK_MIN_PROGRESS) {
155	            task.stuckTicks += STUCK_WINDOW;
156	         } else {
157	            task.stuckTicks = 0;
158	         }
159	         task.checkpoint = here;
160	         task.checkpointTick = task.ticks;
161	      }
162	      if (task.stuckTicks >= STUCK_LIMIT) {
163	         if (task.repathed) {
164	            finish(agent, task, "stuck");
165	            return;
166	         }
167	         task.repathed = true;
168	         task.stuckTicks = 0;
169	         Path again = PathAdvisor.to(agent.level(), here, task.target, MAX_PATH_LENGTH);
170	         if (again == null || again.getNodeCount() <= 1) {
171	            finish(agent, task, "stuck_no_alternative");
172	            return;
173	         }
174	         task.path = again;
175	         Mcbuddy.LOGGER.info("[mcbuddy] task {} stuck at {}, repathing", task.id, here);
176	      }
177	
178	      Vec3 next = task.closing ? task.target : task.path.getNextEntityPos(agent);
179	      if (next == null) {
180	         finish(agent, task, "no_next_node");
181	         return;
182	      }
183	      Vec3 toNode = clampStride(here, next);
184	      Vec3 toTarget = clampStride(here, task.target);
185	      Vec3 stepped = here;
186	      String via = "blocked";
187	      boolean sawFooting = false;
188	      @Nullable
189	      BlockPos blocker = null;
190	      // Two headings, each tried with the resolved footing first and then level: the route's next node,
191	      // and straight at the goal. Only the node heading is what the advisor knows about, so when it is
192	      // blocked the goal heading is the one chance to keep moving without a re-plan.
193	      for (Vec3 candidate : new Vec3[]{ toNode, toTarget }) {
194	         Double rest = restHeight(agent.level(), here, candidate.x, candidate.z);
195	         if (rest == null) {
196	            blocker = BlockPos.containing(candidate.x, here.y, candidate.z);
197	            continue;
198	         }
199	         sawFooting = true;
200	         Vec3 withHeight = new Vec3(candidate.x, rest, candidate.z);
201	         AABB blocked = firstNewCollision(agent, withHeight);
202	         if (blocked == null) {
203	            stepped = withHeight;
204	            via = candidate == toNode ? "step" : "toward target";
205	            blocker = null;
206	            break;
207	         }
208	         Vec3 levelled = new Vec3(candidate.x, here.y, candidate.z);
209	         AABB blockedLevel = firstNewCollision(agent, levelled);
210	         if (blockedLevel == null) {
211	            stepped = levelled;
212	            via = candidate == toNode ? "level" : "level toward target";
213	            blocker = null;
214	            task.degraded++;
215	            break;
216	         }
217	         blocker = BlockPos.containing(blockedLevel.getCenter());
218	      }
219	      boolean refusedNow = "blocked".equals(via);
220	      if (refusedNow) {
221	         task.refused++;
222	         task.noteWedge(agent, toNode, sawFooting ? "blocked" : "no footing");
223	         if (blocker != null) {
224	            // The whole point: the plan that walks us into this cell again is the same plan.
225	            PathAdvisor.forbid(agent.level(), blocker);
226	         }
227	      }
228	      // A refused stride says the route is wrong, not that we cannot walk, so ask for another one
229	      // before giving up: the trunk we walked into stays where it is, but the advisor can go around it.
230	      // Only after that second route fails too do we call it wedged.
231	      task.refusalStreak = refusedNow ? task.refusalStreak + 1 : 0;
232	      if (task.refusalStreak >= WEDGE_LIMIT) {
233	         if (task.repathed) {
234	            finish(agent, task, "wedged");
235	            return;
236	         }
237	         task.repathed = true;
238	         task.refusalStreak = 0;
239	         Path around = PathAdvisor.to(agent.level(), here, task.target, MAX_PATH_LENGTH);
240	         if (around == null || around.getNodeCount() <= 1) {
241	            finish(agent, task, "wedged_no_alternative");
242	            return;
243	         }
244	         task.path = around;
245	         Mcbuddy.LOGGER.info("[mcbuddy] task {} wedged at {}, routing around", task.id, here);
246	      }
247	      if (task.ticks <= 8) {
248	         Mcbuddy.LOGGER.info(
249	               "[mcbuddy] task {} stride {}: {} -> {} via {}",
250	               task.id,
251	               task.ticks,
252	               here,
253	               stepped,
254	               via
255	            );
256	      }
257	      float yaw = (float)Math.toDegrees(-Math.atan2(stepped.x - here.x, stepped.z - here.z));
258	      BuddyAgent.sendInbound(
259	            new ServerboundMovePlayerPacket.PosRot(
260	                  stepped.x, stepped.y, stepped.z, wrap(yaw), agent.getXRot(), agent.onGround(), agent.horizontalCollision
261	               )
262	         );
263	      // A real client closes its tick with this packet, and that is what clears the server's
264	      // "already received a position this tick" flag; without it the second stride is a kick.
265	      BuddyAgent.sendInbound(ServerboundClientTickEndPacket.INSTANCE);
266	      advanceIfClose(agent, task);
267	   }
268	
269	   /**
270	    * Mirrors the test ServerGamePacketListenerImpl applies to a claimed position
271	    * (isEntityCollidingWithAnythingNew, :1306-1316): a target box touching geometry the current box
272	    * does not is a setback, and a setback latches a teleport that drops every later position.
273	    * Returns the offending shape's bounds so the caller can name it, or null when the step is clean.
274	    */
275	   @Nullable
276	   private static AABB firstNewCollision(final ServerPlayer agent, final Vec3 to) {
277	      AABB oldAABB = agent.getBoundingBox();
278	      AABB newAABB = oldAABB.move(to.x - agent.getX(), to.y - agent.getY(), to.z - agent.getZ());
279	      VoxelShape oldShape = Shapes.create(oldAABB.deflate(1.0E-5));
280	      for (VoxelShape shape : agent.level()
281	         .getPreMoveCollisions(agent, newAABB.deflate(1.0E-5), oldAABB.getBottomCenter())) {
282	         if (!Shapes.joinIsNotEmpty(shape, oldShape, BooleanOp.AND)) {
283	            return shape.bounds();
284	         }
285	      }
286	      return null;
287	   }
288	
289	   /**
290	    * Names what we ran into, once per task, so a wedge is answered by the event itself rather than by
291	    * asking a human to look at the screen. Sampling the single block under the target is not enough:
292	    * the body is 0.6 wide, so its box straddles columns.
293	    */
294	   private void noteWedge(final ServerPlayer agent, final Vec3 wanted, final String why) {
295	      if (this.wedgeDetail != null) {
296	         return;
297	      }
298	      ServerLevel level = agent.level();
299	      if (!"blocked".equals(why)) {
300	         // No footing says nothing about collision: report what we found under the feet instead.
301	         BlockPos below = BlockPos.containing(wanted.x, agent.getY() - 1, wanted.z);
302	         this.wedgeDetail = "no footing; below=" + bare(level.getBlockState(below).getBlock().getDescriptionId())
303	            + "@"
304	            + below.getX()
305	            + ","
306	            + below.getY()
307	            + ","
308	            + below.getZ();
309	         return;
310	      }
311	      AABB hit = firstNewCollision(agent, wanted);
312	      if (hit == null) {
313	         this.wedgeDetail = "our predicate found nothing; the server disagreed for another reason";
314	         return;
315	      }
316	      BlockPos at = BlockPos.containing(hit.getCenter());
317	      String block = bare(level.getBlockState(at).getBlock().getDescriptionId());
318	      int entities = level.getEntities(agent, hit, other -> true).size();
319	      this.wedgeDetail = block + "@" + at.getX() + "," + at.getY() + "," + at.getZ() + " entities=" + entities;
320	   }
321	
322	   private static String bare(final String descriptionId) {
323	      int colon = descriptionId.indexOf(':');
324	      return colon >= 0 ? descriptionId.substring(colon + 1) : descriptionId;
325	   }
326	
327	   private static void advanceIfClose(final ServerPlayer agent, final WalkTask task) {
328	      int index = task.path.getNextNodeIndex();
329	      if (index >= task.path.getNodeCount()) {
330	         return;
331	      }
332	      BlockPos node = task.path.getNodePos(index);
333	      Vec3 nodeCenter = new Vec3(node.getX() + 0.5, node.getY(), node.getZ() + 0.5);
334	      if (planar(agent.position(), nodeCenter) < 0.7) {
335	         task.path.advance();
336	      }
337	   }
338	
339	   private static double planar(final Vec3 a, final Vec3 b) {
340	      return new Vec3(b.x - a.x, 0.0, b.z - a.z).horizontalDistance();
341	   }
342	
343	   /** A raw y from the caller is usually inside terrain; path to the surface instead. */
344	   private static Vec3 surfaceSnapped(final ServerLevel level, final Vec3 target) {
345	      int surfaceY = level.getHeight(Heightmap.Types.MOTION_BLOCKING, BlockPos.containing(target).getX(), BlockPos.containing(target).getZ());
346	      return new Vec3(target.x, surfaceY, target.z);
347	   }
348	
349	   /** Horizontal progress toward the node, at most one stride; the caller resolves the height. */
350	   private static Vec3 clampStride(final Vec3 from, final Vec3 to) {
351	      double dx = to.x - from.x;
352	      double dz = to.z - from.z;
353	      double planar = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);
354	      if (planar > STRIDE) {
355	         double scale = STRIDE / planar;
356	         dx *= scale;
357	         dz *= scale;
358	      }
359	      return new Vec3(from.x + dx, from.y, from.z + dz);
360	   }
361	
362	   /**
363	    * The height the agent would come to rest at if it stepped into this column: the highest y within
364	    * one block of its current feet that has air for the whole body and solid ground underneath.
365	    * Rising or falling more than a block in one stride is something we have not simulated, so it is
366	    * reported as no footing rather than claimed.
367	    */
368	   @Nullable
369	   private static Double restHeight(final ServerLevel level, final Vec3 from, final double x, final double z) {
370	      int feet = BlockPos.containing(x, from.y, z).getY();
371	      BlockPos.MutableBlockPos probe = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();
372	      for (int y = feet + MAX_CHANGE; y >= feet - MAX_CHANGE; y--) {
373	         probe.set(x, y, z);
374	         if (!level.getBlockState(probe).isAir()) {
375	            continue;
376	         }
377	         probe.set(x, y + 1, z);
378	         if (!level.getBlockState(probe).isAir()) {
379	            continue;
380	         }
381	         probe.set(x, y - 1, z);
382	         // Only "is there something under the feet" - water and leaves are fine to stand in or on,
383	         // because firstNewCollision is the real gate here and neither has a collision shape that a
384	         // horizontal stride touches. Requiring solid ground instead wedges the agent in a swamp.
385	         if (level.getBlockState(probe).isAir()) {
386	            continue;
387	         }
388	         return (double)y;
389	      }
390	      return null;
391	   }
392	
393	   private static float wrap(final float degrees) {
394	      return (float)((degrees + 180.0) % 360.0 - 180.0);
395	   }
396	
397	   private static void finish(final ServerPlayer agent, final WalkTask task, final String status) {
398	      current = null;
399	      JsonObject event = new JsonObject();
400	      event.addProperty("task_id", task.id);
401	      event.addProperty("status", status);
402	      event.addProperty("ticks", task.ticks);
403	      event.addProperty("straight_line_blocks", Math.round(task.straightLine * 10.0) / 10.0);
404	      Vec3 ended = agent.position();
405	      event.addProperty("strides_refused", task.refused);
406	      event.addProperty("strides_degraded", task.degraded);
407	      if (task.wedgeDetail != null) {
408	         event.addProperty("blocked_by", task.wedgeDetail);
409	      }
410	      event.addProperty("x", Math.round(ended.x * 10.0) / 10.0);
411	      event.addProperty("y", Math.round(ended.y * 10.0) / 10.0);
412	      event.addProperty("z", Math.round(ended.z * 10.0) / 10.0);
413	      EventQueue.add("walk", event);
414	      Mcbuddy.LOGGER.info(
415	            "[mcbuddy] walk task {} -> {} after {} ticks at {} (refused={} degraded={})",
416	            task.id,
417	            status,
418	            task.ticks,
419	            ended,
420	            task.refused,
421	            task.degraded
422	         );
423	   }
424	}

Now I've read the real `handlePlayerPositionChange` in 26.3. Let me extract the key facts for P3:

1. **Jump trigger** (:1176-1178): `if (this.player.onGround() && !isOnGround && movedUpwards) { this.player.jumpFromGround(); }` — where `movedUpwards = yDist > 0.0` with `yDist = targetY - this.lastGoodY` (note: relative to `lastGoodY`, not current!). And `isOnGround` is the packet's flag. So: send a packet that (a) claims y above lastGoodY (rising), (b) has `onGround=false` in packet, while server-side `player.onGround()` is true → server calls `jumpFromGround()`.

Wait — `movedUpwards` is computed from `lastGoodY` which is where the player's last accepted position was. And the check `this.player.onGround()` — server-side onGround state. Note `onGround` on the ServerPlayer is updated by `setOnGroundWithMovement(isOnGround, ...)` at :1222 from previous packet. So the sequence for a jump:
- Tick N: standing; packet says onGround=true; server: `player.onGround()` true, `isOnGround` (packet) true → no jump trigger.
- Tick N+1: client (us) claims y+0.42, onGround=false, rising → server sees `player.onGround()` true (from tick N state), `!isOnGround` true, `movedUpwards` true → calls `player.jumpFromGround()`.

2. **The judge (fail/moved wrongly)** (:1185-1203): 
- `player.move(MoverType.PLAYER, new Vec3(xDist, yDist, zDist))` where xDist = targetX - lastGoodX (i.e., delta from last *accepted* position), NOT from current. Then:
- residual computed vs `player.getX()` after the move: `xDist = targetX - player.getX()` etc.
- y residual zeroed by the (always-true) condition; **x/z residuals** matter.
- `fail = true` if `movedDist > 0.0625` (= 0.25² per axis... x²+z² > 0.0625, i.e. horizontal residual > 0.25) AND not creative/spectator/etc.
- If `fail` → logs "moved wrongly!".
- THEN the accept path: `if (noPhysics || isSleeping || (!fail || !level.noCollision(...)) && !isEntityCollidingWithAnythingNew(...))` → accept (absSnapTo + onGround update + fall damage check + reset fall if movedUpwards). ELSE → `teleport(startX, startY, startZ)` = SETBACK to where it was before this packet (startX = player.getX() before move).

Key insight: **the fail path doesn't immediately setback — it set-backs only if fail AND the new AABB collides with stuff at destination that the old didn't.** Actually read carefully:

```java
if (this.player.noPhysics || this.player.isSleeping() || (!fail || !level.noCollision(this.player, oldAABB)) && !this.isEntityCollidingWithAnythingNew(...)) {
   // accept
} else {

}
```

Operator precedence: `A || B || (C && D)` where C = `(!fail || !noCollision(player, oldAABB))`, D = `!isEntityCollidingWithAnythingNew(...)`. Hmm, so accept requires `(!fail || !level.noCollision(this.player, oldAABB)) && !isEntityCollidingWithAnythingNew(...)`. 

`level.noCollision(this.player, oldAABB)` — checks whether old AABB is free; if the player is currently embedded in blocks (noCollision false → `!noCollision` true), then `!fail || true` = true. Interesting: if you're already stuck in geometry, the fail flag is ignored (can't blame you).

So in creative (`fail` never true): accept iff `!isEntityCollidingWithAnythingNew`. In survival: accept iff (no new collision) AND (fail ? !noCollision(old) : true).

Hmm wait, actually for survival: accept = `(!fail || !noCollision(player, oldAABB)) && !newCollision`. 1. **生存校正实验**（半天，文档钦定的第一步）。前提要加一个 dev 桥接操作 `agent.gamemode`（现在 spawn 硬编码创造，BuddyAgent:131，没有切换入口）。跑 arrivetest + 三条 walktest，数：moved wrongly / setback / via step 是否照样过 / 到达精度。产出事实表，决定弹道器覆盖哪些形态。
2. **弹道器**（核心提交）：WalkTask 加模式机 {WALK, JUMP, FALL}。JUMP：t0 发触发包（airborne+rising），t1..tn 按积分器声称 y，水平照旧 clampStride；被挡就把该 tick 降级成"垂直-only 声称"（=贴墙滑行，真客户端同样行为）。FALL 同理，落地 tick 声称 onGround=true。事件 via 加 `jump t3/7`、`fall t2/6`。
3. **政策**：restHeight 上下界拆开（+1 / -N 可配置）；向上 >1 仍拒（那是垫脚的事）。
4. **垫脚组合子**：`BuddyAgent` 或 PTC 层加 `pillarUp`：jump → 脚位 ≥ 原格+1 的首 tick 对原脚位格 place → 落 → 循环；之后 walkTo 接管。
5. **验收（P3 定义草案）**：① 跳 1-2 格宽沟；② 上/下 3 格崖（生存核对 fall damage）；③ 2 格坑里垫脚出来；④ 全程零 setback / 零 moved-wrongly / 零 floating kick；创造+生存各跑一遍。

要你拍的三个决定：
- **飞**：创造下给不给？技术零成本（创造免判罚），产品上等于允许凭空盖楼。建议先不做。
- **摔伤策略**：>3 格下落允许疼，还是路径代价层面避开？建议先允许 + 事件上报，不动代价函数。
- **范围**：跨缺口上限做成 1-2 格（保守）还是按弹道器能算多少算多少？

有。方向一句话：**把 WalkTask 的垂直分量从"查表"（restHeight ±1 窗口）升级成"逐 tick 弹道声称"（jump / fall 两个模式）；水平的整套链路（clampStride、`firstNewCollision` 三级退让、禁入集合、事件）一行不动**。所有新声称仍然必须先过 `firstNewCollision` 才准发。

刚才把四个分叉点从 26.3 源码核实了一遍（都带行号）：

1. **服务端永远不替我们飞。** `Player.isClientAuthoritative()`=true（`Player:1258`）→ `travel()` 的闸门（`LivingEntity:3139`，`canSimulateMovement() && isEffectiveAi()`）对 ServerPlayer 不过 → 服务端唯一做的事是拿"声称 delta"调 `player.move(MoverType.PLAYER,…)` 复算碰撞（`:1185`），末了 `absSnapTo` 我们的声称（`:1209`）。弹道必须我们算、我们声称。
2. **判罚罚的是水平残差，且 Y 轴恒先动。** `:1186-1203`：x/z 残差 >0.25 格且非创造 → `moved wrongly` → **当 tick 立即 setback**（`:1238`）；y 残差被恒真条件清零。而 `collide` 的轴序（`Direction.axisStepOrder:390`）**Y 永远第一** —— 意思是"先升 1 格再横移、边界接触不算碰撞"，我们现有的 **`via step` 声称在生存判罚下大概率本来就站得住**。这是推断，正是第一步实验要测掉的东西。
3. **跳跃触发确认**：包报"离地 + y 上升"而服务端 onGround=true → `:1176-1178` 服务端自己调 `jumpFromGround()`（`LivingEntity:2385`）。它只完成"起跳"状态，弧线仍归我们。
4. **弹道不用发明**：`BASE_JUMP_POWER=0.42`、重力 0.08、垂直阻力 0.98，积分顺序照抄 `travelInAir`（`:2464-2489`，每 tick 先位移再 gravity+drag），十几行。另两个已存在的闸门：下降伤害由 `doCheckFallDamage`（`:1223`）按我们的声称记账（≤3 格不疼，>3 疼痛度和真人一致）；连续离地 >80 tick 会被当"飞"踢（`:373`）——跳/落 ~12 tick 尺度，安全。

由此 P3 的重定性：**它主要不是"抢救步态合法性"，而是补三个竖直动词**——
- **跨缺口**：中间列没有 footing，现在直接拒，要允许短时空中声称；
- **多格下降**：restHeight 下界从 -1 放到 -N（可配置），下落段按弹道声称；
- **垫脚**：跳 + 空中对脚下格 `place`，零件全有。
老的"上 1 格"走 `via step`，按协议诚实起见在跳的时候补触发包+真弧线（和真玩家同构）。

施工顺序：

1. **生存校正实验**（半天，文档钦定第一步）。前提：加一个 dev 桥接操作 `agent.gamemode`（现在 spawn 硬编码创造，`BuddyAgent:131`，没有切换入口）。跑 arrivetest + 三条 walktest，数 moved wrongly / setback / `via step` 是否照样过 / 到达精度。产出事实表。
2. **弹道器**（核心提交）：WalkTask 加模式机 `{WALK, JUMP, FALL}`。JUMP：t0 发触发包（airborne+rising），t1..tn 按积分器声称 y，水平照旧；被挡的 tick 降级成"垂直-only 声称"（=贴墙滑行，真客户端同样行为）。FALL 同理，落地 tick 声称 onGround=true。事件 via 加 `jump t3/7`、`fall t2/6`，探针可数。
3. **政策参数**：restHeight 上下界拆开；向上 >1 仍拒（垫脚的活）。
4. **垫脚组合子**：`pillarUp`：jump → 脚位 ≥ 原格+1 的首 tick 对原脚位格 place → 落 → 循环。
5. **验收草案**：① 跳 1–2 格宽沟；② 上/下 3 格崖（生存核对 fall damage）；③ 2 格坑里垫出来；④ 全程零 setback / 零 moved-wrongly / 零 floating kick；创造+生存各跑一遍。

要你拍的三个决定：**飞**（创造给不给模型用，建议先不做）、**摔伤策略**（>3 格允许疼 + 事件上报，还是路径代价避开）、**范围**（跨缺口上限 1–2 格保守起步，还是按弹道器能算多少算多少）。

344	   private static Vec3 surfaceSnapped(final ServerLevel level, final Vec3 target) {
345	      int surfaceY = level.getHeight(Heightmap.Types.MOTION_BLOCKING, BlockPos.containing(target).getX(), BlockPos.containing(target).getZ());
346	      return new Vec3(target.x, surfaceY, target.z);
347	   }

349	   /** Horizontal progress toward the node, at most one stride; the caller resolves the height. */
350	   private static Vec3 clampStride(final Vec3 from, final Vec3 to) {
351	      double dx = to.x - from.x;
352	      double dz = to.z - from.z;
353	      double planar = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);
354	      if (planar > STRIDE) {
355	         double scale = STRIDE / planar;
356	         dx *= scale;
357	         dz *= scale;
358	      }
359	      return new Vec3(from.x + dx, from.y, from.z + dz);
360	   }

363	    * The height the agent would come to rest at if it stepped into this column: the highest y within
364	    * one block of its current feet that has air for the whole body and solid ground underneath.
365	    * Rising or falling more than a block in one stride is something we have not simulated, so it is
366	    * reported as no footing rather than claimed.
367	    */
368	   @Nullable
369	   private static Double restHeight(final ServerLevel level, final Vec3 from, final double x, final double z) {
370	      int feet = BlockPos.containing(x, from.y, z).getY();
371	      BlockPos.MutableBlockPos probe = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();
372	      for (int y = feet + MAX_CHANGE; y >= feet - MAX_CHANGE; y--) {
373	         probe.set(x, y, z);
374	         if (!level.getBlockState(probe).isAir()) {
375	            continue;
376	         }
377	         probe.set(x, y + 1, z);
378	         if (!level.getBlockState(probe).isAir()) {
379	            continue;
380	         }
381	         probe.set(x, y - 1, z);
382	         // Only "is there something under the feet" - water and leaves are fine to stand in or on,
383	         // because firstNewCollision is the real gate here and neither has a collision shape that a
384	         // horizontal stride touches. Requiring solid ground instead wedges the agent in a swamp.
385	         if (level.getBlockState(probe).isAir()) {
386	            continue;
387	         }
388	         return (double)y;
389	      }
390	      return null;
391	   }

397	   private static void finish(final ServerPlayer agent, final WalkTask task, final String status) {
398	      current = null;
399	      JsonObject event = new JsonObject();
400	      event.addProperty("task_id", task.id);
401	      event.addProperty("status", status);
402	      event.addProperty("ticks", task.ticks);
403	      event.addProperty("straight_line_blocks", Math.round(task.straightLine * 10.0) / 10.0);
404	      Vec3 ended = agent.position();
405	      event.addProperty("strides_refused", task.refused);
406	      event.addProperty("strides_degraded", task.degraded);
407	      if (task.wedgeDetail != null) {
408	         event.addProperty("blocked_by", task.wedgeDetail);
409	      }
410	      event.addProperty("x", Math.round(ended.x * 10.0) / 10.0);
411	      event.addProperty("y", Math.round(ended.y * 10.0) / 10.0);
412	      event.addProperty("z", Math.round(ended.z * 10.0) / 10.0);
413	      EventQueue.add("walk", event);
414	      Mcbuddy.LOGGER.info(
415	            "[mcbuddy] walk task {} -> {} after {} ticks at {} (refused={} degraded={})",
416	            task.id,
417	            status,
418	            task.ticks,
419	            ended,

      if (gravity < 1.0E-5F) {

      } else {

         return Mth.ceil(80.0 * Math.max(gravityModifier, 1.0));

20	/**
21	 * Vanilla A* is typed to Mob, and the agent has to be a player, so path computation borrows a
22	 * throwaway cow. It is never added to the level, which is what keeps it invisible: entity tracking
23	 * only ever sees entities the level holds.
24	 */
25	public final class PathAdvisor {
26	   // PathFinder aborts its search the instant visited nodes hit this budget, so 0 means "expand
27	   // nothing" and hands back a 1-node path. Vanilla's budget is FOLLOW_RANGE * 16
28	   // (PathNavigation:64 and :72); our max path length is 60, so 960 keeps the same ratio.
29	   private static final int MAX_VISITED_NODES = 960;
30	   private static final long NO_GO_TICKS = 100L;
31	   /**
32	    * BlockPos.asLong -> the tick it stops being held against the route. The evaluator's own path-type
33	    * cache cannot be invalidated from outside, so a refusal is honoured by making the cell report
34	    * BLOCKED for a while instead of by editing the cache.
35	    */
36	   private static final Map<Long, Long> NO_GO = new HashMap<>();
37	   private static final PathFinder FINDER = new PathFinder(new NoGoEvaluator(), MAX_VISITED_NODES);
38	   @Nullable
39	   private static Mob advisor;
40	   @Nullable
41	   private static ServerLevel advisorLevel;
42	
43	   private static final class NoGoEvaluator extends WalkNodeEvaluator {
44	      @Override
45	      protected PathType getCachedPathType(final int x, final int y, final int z) {
46	         return NO_GO.containsKey(BlockPos.asLong(x, y, z)) ? PathType.BLOCKED : super.getCachedPathType(x, y, z);
47	      }
48	   }
49	
50	   /**
51	    * Tell the advisor that this cell just made us refuse a stride, so the next plan routes around it.
52	    * Without this a re-plan from where we stand returns the same blocked first node - the thrash
53	    * measured on the mangrove spawn, where every re-plan aimed at the same vine.
54	    */
55	   public static void forbid(final ServerLevel level, final BlockPos pos) {
56	      long tick = level.getServer().getTickCount();
57	      NO_GO.put(BlockPos.asLong(pos.getX(), pos.getY(), pos.getZ()), tick + NO_GO_TICKS);
58	      NO_GO.values().removeIf(expiry -> expiry <= tick);
59	   }
60	
61	   @Nullable
62	   public static Path to(final ServerLevel level, final Vec3 from, final Vec3 target, final float maxLength) {
63	      NO_GO.values().removeIf(expiry -> expiry <= level.getServer().getTickCount());
64	      Mob mob = advisorFor(level, from);
65	      if (mob == null) {
66	         return null;
67	      }
68	      mob.setPos(from.x, from.y, from.z);
69	      // Same construction vanilla's own navigation uses: a bounded box around the start, which also
70	      // caps how much of the world one path query can touch.
71	      BlockPos center = BlockPos.containing(from);
72	      int radius = (int)Math.ceil(maxLength) + 2;
73	      PathNavigationRegion region = new PathNavigationRegion(
74	            level, center.offset(-radius, -radius, -radius), center.offset(radius, radius, radius)
75	         );
76	      // reachRange 0: the path must end exactly on the target node. Vanilla mobs pass 1 because a mob
77	      // only needs to get near things, but with 1 a target one step away sets "reached" on the start
78	      // node itself (PathFinder:94 tests distanceManhattan <= reachRange), and the caller gets a
79	      // 1-node path whose end is the start - measured as "pathfinder produced no route" for every
80	      // single-block walk, even when a detour existed.
81	      Path path = FINDER.findPath(region, mob, Set.of(BlockPos.containing(target)), maxLength, 0, 1.0F);
82	      Mcbuddy.LOGGER.info(
83	            "[mcbuddy] path {} -> {}: {}",
84	            center,
85	            BlockPos.containing(target),
86	            path == null
87	               ? "null"
88	               : "nodes=" + path.getNodeCount() + " reach=" + path.canReach() + " end=" + path.getEndNode()
89	         );
90	      return path;
91	   }
92	
93	   @Nullable
94	   private static Mob advisorFor(final ServerLevel level, final Vec3 from) {
95	      if (advisor == null || advisorLevel != level) {
96	         advisor = EntityTypes.COW.create(level, EntitySpawnReason.TRIGGERED);
97	         advisorLevel = level;
98	      }
99	      Mob mob = advisor;
100	      if (mob != null) {
101	         mob.setPos(from.x, from.y, from.z);
102	      }
103	      return mob;
104	   }

151	   @Nullable
152	   private static Vec3 standableSpotNear(final ServerLevel level, final Vec3 anchor, final int maxRadius) {
153	      BlockPos anchorPos = BlockPos.containing(anchor);
154	      for (int radius = 1; radius <= maxRadius; radius++) {
155	         for (int dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++) {
156	            for (int dz = -radius; dz <= radius; dz++) {
157	               if (Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dz)) != radius) {
158	                  continue;
159	               }
160	               // Down the column, not just beside it: the highest thing worth standing on is usually a
161	               // canopy, and the advisor treats leaves as blocked, so no route ever leaves the top of
162	               // one. Real ground is below it.
163	               for (int y = anchorPos.getY() + MAX_RISE; y >= anchorPos.getY() - MAX_DROP; y--) {
164	                  BlockPos feet = anchorPos.offset(dx, y - anchorPos.getY(), dz);
165	                  if (standable(level, feet)) {
166	                     return new Vec3(feet.getX() + 0.5, feet.getY(), feet.getZ() + 0.5);
167	                  }
168	               }
169	            }
170	         }
171	      }
172	      return null;
173	   }

175	   /**
176	    * Air for the body, ground under the feet, and somewhere to step: a pocket that satisfies the first
177	    * two is a cage, and from a cage every claimed step collides, so the agent could never leave it no
178	    * matter how good the route was. The exit only needs air to move into - the drop or step up beyond
179	    * it is the server's to resolve, which is why a ledge counts as an exit and a wall does not.
180	    */
181	   private static boolean standable(final ServerLevel level, final BlockPos feet) {
182	      if (!roomFor(level, feet)) {
183	         return false;
184	      }
185	      int exits = 0;
186	      for (BlockPos side : new BlockPos[]{ feet.east(), feet.west(), feet.north(), feet.south() }) {
187	         if (clearAt(level, side)) {
188	            exits++;
189	         }
190	      }
191	      // Two, not one: a single open neighbour can be the only way out of a pocket, and the route the
192	      // advisor wants may point the other way. Measured: an agent with exactly one exit wedged with
193	      // refused=24 degraded=24 without moving a block, because every re-plan aimed at the wall.
194	      return exits >= 2;
195	   }

197	   private static boolean roomFor(final ServerLevel level, final BlockPos feet) {
198	      return clearAt(level, feet) && ground(level.getBlockState(feet.below()));
199	   }

201	   /**
202	    * Leaves hold a player up but WalkNodeEvaluator classifies them as PathType.LEAVES, whose -1.0F
203	    * malus is the same sentinel as BLOCKED - so a canopy is a floor to us and a wall to the advisor, and
204	    * no route ever leaves the top of one. Fluids are not a floor at all: they hold nothing up.
205	    */
206	   private static boolean ground(final BlockState below) {
207	      return !below.isAir() && !below.is(BlockTags.LEAVES) && !below.liquid();
208	   }

346	      // silently widen the rate limit.
347	      sayRate.tick();
348	      answerKeepAlive(self);
349	      // Order matters: connection.tick() clears the per-tick "already received a position this tick"
350	      // flag inside tickPlayer/resetPosition, so a stride sent before it looks like a second packet.
351	      self.connection.tick();
352	      ackPendingTeleport(self);
353	      WalkTask.tick(self);
354	   }

360	    */

451	   /**
452	    * Right-click a neighbouring block's face so vanilla puts the held block into the target cell,
453	    * which is the only way a player can place anything: the hit is always on an existing block. We
454	    * choose which face to click, the server decides whether the placement happens
455	    * (ServerGamePacketListenerImpl:1408-1450 - reach, build limit, spawn protection, mayInteract).
456	    *
457	    * The report deliberately includes the two things that make this silently fail and are otherwise
458	    * invisible from outside: an empty hand, and a latched teleport (:1435 drops the whole interaction
459	    * while one is pending).
460	    */

462	      return placeAt(target, null);
463	   }

465	   public static JsonObject placeAt(final BlockPos target, final String bp) {
466	      JsonObject out = new JsonObject();
467	      ServerPlayer self = agent;
468	      if (self == null) {
469	         out.addProperty("placed", false);
470	         out.addProperty("reason", "no agent spawned");
471	         return out;
472	      }
473	      ServerLevel level = self.level();
474	      ItemStack held = self.getInventory().getSelectedItem();
475	      out.addProperty("held", describe(held));
476	      out.addProperty("teleport_latched", teleportLatched(self));
477	      if (held.isEmpty()) {
478	         out.addProperty("placed", false);
479	         out.addProperty("reason", "empty hand - agent.pick first");
480	         return out;
481	      }
482	      BlockPos support = null;
483	      Direction face = null;
484	      for (Direction towards : Direction.values()) {
485	         BlockPos candidate = target.relative(towards);
486	         if (!level.getBlockState(candidate).isAir()) {
487	            support = candidate;
488	            face = towards.getOpposite();
489	            break;
490	         }
491	      }
492	      if (support == null) {
493	         out.addProperty("placed", false);
494	         out.addProperty("reason", "no solid neighbour to click from");
495	         return out;
496	      }
497	      // Midpoint of the two cell centres is exactly the shared face, and sits 0.5 from the clicked
498	      // block's centre, inside the |distance| < 1.0000001 test at :1422.
499	      Vec3 hit = Vec3.atCenterOf(support).add(Vec3.atCenterOf(target)).scale(0.5);
500	      out.addProperty("support", blockId(level.getBlockState(support)));
501	      out.addProperty("within_reach", self.isWithinBlockInteractionRange(support, 1.0));
502	      String before = blockId(level.getBlockState(target));
503	      sendInbound(
504	            new ServerboundUseItemOnPacket(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND, new BlockHitResult(hit, face, support, false), nextSequence())
505	         );
506	      String after = blockId(level.getBlockState(target));
507	      out.addProperty("target_before", before);
508	      out.addProperty("target_after", after);
509	      out.addProperty("placed", !after.equals(before));
510	      if (!after.equals(before)) {
511	         // The blueprint records the transition the world accepted, not the cell the plan asked for, so
512	         // a placement that silently no-oped can never be "remembered" as built.
513	         EditLog.record(
514	               "place",
515	               target.getX(),
516	               target.getY(),
517	               target.getZ(),
518	               before,
519	               after,
520	               bp,
521	               level.getServer().getTickCount()
522	            );
523	      }
524	      Mcbuddy.LOGGER.info(
525	            "[mcbuddy] place into {} by clicking {} face {}: {} -> {} (latched={})",
526	            target,
527	            support,
528	            face,
529	            before,
530	            after,
531	            Boolean.valueOf(teleportLatched(self))
532	         );
533	      return out;
534	   }

573	               pos.getZ(),

578	            );

581	      return out;

584	   /**
585	    * Where the agent would have to stand to touch this cell. Uses vanilla's own test rather than a
586	    * formula of our own: Player:1998-2001 compares the target AABB against the eye position with
587	    * blockInteractionRange() plus the 1.0 buffer every server caller passes, so the answer here cannot
588	    * drift from what the server will later accept. Candidates are searched outward from the target and
589	    * must satisfy the same standable rule used at spawn.
590	    */
591	   public static JsonObject standFor(final BlockPos target, final int maxRadius) {
592	      JsonObject out = new JsonObject();
593	      ServerPlayer self = agent;
594	      if (self == null) {
595	         out.addProperty("reachable", false);
596	         out.addProperty("reason", "no agent spawned");
597	         return out;
598	      }
599	      ServerLevel level = self.level();
600	      double eyeAboveFeet = self.getEyePosition().y - self.getY();
601	      double maxRange = self.blockInteractionRange() + 1.0;
602	      AABB box = new AABB(target);
603	      out.addProperty("range_blocks", maxRange);
604	      for (int radius = 1; radius <= maxRadius; radius++) {
605	         for (int dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++) {
606	            for (int dz = -radius; dz <= radius; dz++) {
607	               if (Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dz)) != radius) {
608	                  continue;
609	               }
610	               for (int dy : HEIGHT_TRIES) {
611	                  BlockPos candidate = target.offset(dx, dy, dz);
612	                  if (!standable(level, candidate)) {
613	                     continue;
614	                  }
615	                  Vec3 eye = new Vec3(candidate.getX() + 0.5, candidate.getY() + eyeAboveFeet, candidate.getZ() + 0.5);
616	                  if (box.distanceToSqr(eye) < maxRange * maxRange) {
617	                     out.addProperty("reachable", true);
618	                     out.addProperty("stand", describe(new Vec3(candidate.getX() + 0.5, candidate.getY(), candidate.getZ() + 0.5)));
619	                     out.addProperty("from_target_blocks", Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dz)));
620	                     return out;
621	                  }
622	               }
623	            }
624	         }
625	      }
626	      out.addProperty("reachable", false);
627	      out.addProperty("reason", "no standable cell within " + maxRadius + " of the target is in range");
628	      return out;
629	   }

631	   /**
632	    * Rig operation, not a player action: put the agent on a specific spot so a test can start from
633	    * known ground. Gated by dev_writes, and it will not drop the agent into geometry - if the exact
634	    * cell is not standable it takes the nearest one that is and reports that it adjusted.
635	    */
636	   public static JsonObject teleportTo(final double x, final double y, final double z) {
637	      JsonObject out = new JsonObject();
638	      ServerPlayer self = agent;
639	      if (self == null) {
640	         out.addProperty("moved", false);
641	         out.addProperty("reason", "no agent spawned");
642	         return out;
643	      }
644	      if (!BuddyConfig.devWrites) {
645	         out.addProperty("moved", false);
646	         out.addProperty("reason", "dev_writes is off - this is a rig operation, not something the agent does");
647	         return out;
648	      }
649	      ServerLevel level = self.level();
650	      BlockPos wanted = BlockPos.containing(x, y, z);
651	      Vec3 spot;
652	      if (standable(level, wanted)) {
653	         spot = new Vec3(wanted.getX() + 0.5, wanted.getY(), wanted.getZ() + 0.5);
654	      } else {
655	         spot = standableSpotNear(level, new Vec3(wanted.getX() + 0.5, wanted.getY(), wanted.getZ() + 0.5), 3);
656	      }
657	      out.addProperty("from", describe(self.position()));
658	      if (spot == null) {
659	         out.addProperty("moved", false);
660	         out.addProperty("reason", "no standable cell at or within 3 of the requested spot");
661	         return out;
662	      }
663	      self.teleportTo(spot.x, spot.y, spot.z);
664	      out.addProperty("moved", true);
665	      out.addProperty("to", describe(spot));
666	      out.addProperty("adjusted", Boolean.valueOf(!describe(spot).equals(describe(new Vec3(wanted.getX() + 0.5, wanted.getY(), wanted.getZ() + 0.5)))));
667	      Mcbuddy.LOGGER.info("[mcbuddy] rig teleport {} -> {}", out.get("from"), describe(spot));
668	      return out;
669	   }

672	      return self.connection instanceof ServerGamePacketListenerImplTeleportAccessor accessor
673	         && accessor.mcbuddy$awaitingPositionFromClient() != null;
674	   }

676	   private static int nextSequence() {
677	      interactionSequence = interactionSequence + 1;
678	      return interactionSequence;

690	   /**
691	    * The agent speaks. A fake player cannot produce a chat signature, so the packet path is closed to
692	    * us: handleChat validates the last-seen checksum first and disconnects on failure (:1706-1715), and
693	    * the signature half needs a key pair we do not have. This calls the endpoint the server itself calls
694	    * once a signed message has cleared (:1738), so the human sees an ordinary chat line from the agent.
695	    * What is skipped is the transport crypto, not the visibility or the chat type.
696	    */
697	   public static JsonObject say(final MinecraftServer server, final String text) {
698	      JsonObject out = new JsonObject();
699	      ServerPlayer self = agent;
700	      if (self == null) {
701	         out.addProperty("said", false);
702	         out.addProperty("reason", "no agent spawned");
703	         return out;
704	      }
705	      String trimmed = text.length() > 256 ? text.substring(0, 256) : text;
706	      if (!sayRate.isUnderThreshold()) {
707	         out.addProperty("said", false);
708	         out.addProperty("reason", "rate_limited");
709	         // An upper bound rather than a measurement: TickThrottler keeps its count private, but the
710	         // count can only ever reach one increment above the window before a say is refused, so waiting
711	         // out one increment is always enough. Without this number a plan would spin on the refusal.
712	         out.addProperty("retry_after_ticks", SAY_COST_TICKS);
713	         return out;
714	      }
715	      sayRate.increment();
716	      server.getPlayerList()
717	         .broadcastChatMessage(PlayerChatMessage.unsigned(self.getUUID(), trimmed), self, ChatType.bind(ChatType.CHAT, self));
718	      out.addProperty("said", true);
719	      out.addProperty("text", trimmed);
720	      Mcbuddy.LOGGER.info("[mcbuddy] agent says: {}", trimmed);
721	      return out;
722	   }

724	   /**
725	    * Where the real players are. A companion that cannot answer "where is the human" cannot follow,
726	    * come to, or avoid them, and every program that wants one of those would otherwise have to guess
727	    * from a chat event that carries a name and no position.
728	    */

730	      JsonArray out = new JsonArray();
731	      ServerPlayer self = agent;
732	      if (self == null) {
733	         return out;
734	      }
735	      for (ServerPlayer other : self.level().getServer().getPlayerList().getPlayers()) {
736	         if (other == self) {
737	            continue;
738	         }
739	         JsonObject entry = new JsonObject();
740	         entry.addProperty("name", other.getName().getString());
741	         entry.addProperty("x", Math.round(other.getX() * 10.0) / 10.0);
742	         entry.addProperty("y", Math.round(other.getY() * 10.0) / 10.0);
743	         entry.addProperty("z", Math.round(other.getZ() * 10.0) / 10.0);
744	         entry.addProperty("dist", Math.round(self.position().distanceTo(other.position()) * 10.0) / 10.0);
745	         out.add(entry);
746	      }
747	      return out;
748	   }

807	    * whose channelRead0 calls packet.handle(listener), so writeInbound is the honest path and

142	   private static String await(final BufferedWriter writer, final JsonObject request) {
143	      Integer id = BridgeJson.idOf(request);
144	      Pending pending = new Pending(writer, request);
145	      QUEUE.add(pending);
146	      synchronized (pending) {
147	         long deadline = System.currentTimeMillis() + 5000L;

155	         }

161	   public static void tick() {
162	      for (int i = 0; i < MAX_PER_TICK; i++) {
163	         Pending pending = QUEUE.poll();
164	         if (pending == null) {
165	            return;
166	         }

169	            pending.response = response;
170	            pending.notifyAll();

      out.addProperty("health", self.getHealth());
      Mcbuddy.LOGGER.info("[mcbuddy] rig gamemode {} -> {} (health={})", before, self.gameMode().getName(), self.getHealth());

519-1. **`reachRange=1` 在曼哈顿语义下让起点自己"到达"**：`PathFinder.findPath` (:94) 的命中判据是 `current.distanceManhattan(target) <= reachRange`，正交单格目标的曼哈顿距离恰好 =1 → **起点节点自己**就被标成 reached，A* 返回 1 节点路径；`WalkTask.start` 的 `getNodeCount() <= 1` 守卫（"唯一节点=起点=没得走"）把它读成"没有路线"拒掉。对角目标的曼哈顿距离 =2 不受影响 —— 所以"四个正交全被拒、对角能 accept"。

7	/** Bounded, cursor-addressed event log so the protocol stays stateless: callers pass the last cursor back. */
8	public final class EventQueue {
9	   private static final int CAPACITY = 256;
10	   private static final ArrayDeque<Entry> ENTRIES = new ArrayDeque<>();
11	   private static long sequence;
12	
13	   private record Entry(long seq, String type, JsonObject data) {
14	   }
15	
16	   public static synchronized void add(final String type, final JsonObject data) {
17	      ENTRIES.addLast(new Entry(++sequence, type, data));
18	      while (ENTRIES.size() > CAPACITY) {
19	         ENTRIES.removeFirst();
20	      }
21	   }
22	
23	   public static synchronized JsonObject poll(final long cursor) {
24	      JsonArray events = new JsonArray();
25	      long newest = cursor;
26	      for (Entry entry : ENTRIES) {
27	         if (entry.seq() > cursor) {
28	            JsonObject wrapper = new JsonObject();
29	            wrapper.addProperty("seq", entry.seq());
30	            wrapper.addProperty("type", entry.type());
31	            wrapper.add("data", entry.data());
32	            events.add(wrapper);
33	            newest = entry.seq();
34	         }
35	      }
36	      JsonObject result = new JsonObject();
37	      result.addProperty("cursor", newest);
38	      result.add("events", events);
39	      long dropped = sequence - (ENTRIES.isEmpty() ? 0 : ENTRIES.peekFirst().seq());
40	      if (dropped > 0) {
41	         result.addProperty("older_than_cursor_dropped", (int)dropped);
42	      }
43	      return result;
44	   }
45	
46	   public static synchronized long latest() {
47	      return sequence;
48	   }
49	}

28	**Listening constraint for the background companion.** Chat arrives in the event queue as `{from, text}`, but `!buddy ...` lines are cancelled at `handleChat`'s HEAD and consumed as commands, so they never reach the event stream. A companion that reacts to his voice therefore sees ordinary chat only, and any command surface has to be read from the command side, not the event side. Bidirectional chat (hear him, reply via `agent.say`) was proven working end to end on 2026-10-04 with no engine change — the inbound wiring already existed from M0.5. **Now measured from the agent surface itself (2026-10-04 14:0x)**: one PTC program read `{type:"chat",from:"Player271",text:"你好"}` out of `m.events(0)` and replied through `m.say`, and `self_echo_in_ring:0` proved the agent's own speech never re-enters the ring — so a companion cannot trigger itself by talking, which is what makes unattended use safe. Hearing him still requires him to type: no code path lets us synthesize an inbound chat packet, so if that loop ever looks untested, the missing input is his keystroke, not a probe.

30	**How the companion gets woken: decided, P0s shipped, watcher not yet written (state 2026-10-04 late).** Everything before was request-driven, so while the outer agent loop sits idle, shouting in Minecraft did nothing. Now decided: a **watchdog** turns `chat` events into a user turn injected into **bugent** (`--resume`, `maxSteps` 800, see [[reference-bugent]]), wake filter server-side (`wake_prefix` = `@buddy`), inbound rate limit mirroring outbound `say`. Both P0s shipped in 43591a3: `bridge_token` (dev config stays empty; enabled only at phase-B go-live) and `m.wait_for` (signature `{match, cursor?, timeout_ms?, poll_ms?}`; `match` = event type or `{type, text}` with text as substring; host-side polling, deadline min(timeout_ms, PLAN_TIMEOUT_MS)). Remaining queue, in order: ① **M5/M6 product acceptance criteria — the only unset P0, the judging standard for "完善了吗"**; ② `scripts/watch.mjs`; ③ bugent side adds one `bugent.game.toml` (systemPromptFile + `[[mcp.servers]]` + `network_allow=["127.0.0.1:25731"]`); ④ live acceptance with a real player typing `@buddy`.

```java
public static JsonObject claim(double x, double y, double z, boolean onGround) {
   // rig: hand one claim to the server and report the verdict, with no gait involved.
   // gate dev_writes; must be called on the server thread; sends PosRot + ClientTickEnd;
   // reads the position after the tick? The verdict is applied synchronously inside handleMovePlayer
   // → writeInbound processes it immediately, so the player's position right after the call IS the verdict.
}
```
That's the beauty: `sendInbound` is synchronous, so after it, `self.position()` shows what the server did (accept → our claim; setback → the teleport). Also detect the latch via `teleportLatched(self)` (awaitingPositionFromClient != null) and `getBoundingBox` overlap. Report: claimed vs achieved, delta, latched (setback pending ack), health, onGround before/after.

Note: after a setback, the server sends a teleport and latches; our per-tick ack logic will clear it next tick (ackPendingTeleport). So report `teleport_latched` immediately: that's the setback flag. 

Also `moved wrongly` will be logged by vanilla → count in the driver.

#### Thinking

Superb, decisive facts:

1. **Fall damage is entirely the landing flag's doing.** Survival: hover 10 → fall 9.8 airborne (fd 9.8) → claim the landing with on_ground=true → **hp 20 → 16 (-4)**. Vanilla damage for fd 10 = floor(10-3)=7? Measured -4 (i.e. 2 hearts = 4 damage). Hmm: fd 9.8 minus 3 = 6.8 → damage 6? measured 4. There's the `updateFallStatus` reduction: when the movement is not continuous, vanilla reduces fd by 0.5 per tick (`fallDistance *= 0.5` at Entity:580 when not falling) → the airborne claim set fd=9.8, then during the 1.2 s sleep between cases (24 ticks) fd decayed (×0.5 each tick when the "falling" condition is false) → by landing it was ~7 → damage 4. Whatever the exact decay, the fact stands: **claiming the landing honestly costs health; claiming it dishonestly (ground=false all the way) costs nothing.** In creative: same claims → hp unchanged (invulnerable) ✓ control.

2. Rises: +1, +2, +6, +10 all accepted in both modes, zero residual. Only the 12-block single claim tripped `moved too quickly` (the budget is |Δ from firstGood|² ≤ ~100 → ~10 blocks). So per-claim magnitude cap ≈ 10 blocks, and the practical design (≤0.5/tick) is far inside it.

3. A claim into the floor is setback by the new-collision test in both modes — and our `firstNewCollision` mirrors exactly that test.

4. The server does NOT simulate the body: the arc must come from our claims (frozen at +0.42 for 25 polls). Velocity persists in the packet-sense (0.4) but no integration.

So the P3 conclusion: we need our own per-tick ballistic claims (the trajectory engine), and the honest jump trigger is *cosmetic but cheap* (it makes vanilla call jumpFromGround, which sets the velocity that later feeds the movement budget and the server's idea of us).

Now, an important nuance for the arc's realism: since the server doesn't integrate, our claims define everything, and the *human watching* sees the body move per claim. With 0.35/tick horizontal and a 0.42 initial vertical + 0.08 gravity + 0.98 drag, we get a ~1.25-block-high, ~4-block-long arc over ~12 ticks — that looks like a real jump.

Also for the walk on the pad, the "no jump needed for +1" fact means: the current gait's failure at the step face (`onto the step` → wedged) is our OWN gate bug: restHeight is computed from the destination column while the body box (0.6 wide) already touches the tall column. The fix is small: resolve the rest height against the columns the *target box* overlaps, then claim the higher y. Measured to be legal (rise +1 accepted, no warnings, no setback, no health cost) — and, as a bonus, no `moved wrongly` in survival.

Now: the estimate. P3 = 
(a) small fix to restHeight/claim resolution so a 1-block climb is claimed (measured legal) — maybe 20 lines.
(b) an arc generator for jumps (gap crossing) and multi-block drops (with the honest landing flag → real damage + event report) — the bulk.
(c) pillar-up: place a block under yourself while airborne + rise claim — composition of existing place + arc.
(d) the floating budget: never exceed ~80 consecutive airborne ticks (source-derived, unmeasured to avoid a kick).

`place` 再上升声称），不需要新机制。\n6. 验收草案（两模式各跑一遍）：跨 1–3 格缺口、上下 3 格崖（带摔伤上报）、2 格坑里垫脚出来、全程零 setback、零 `moved wrongly`、零 `moved too quickly`、空中时长不超 80 tick。\n\n### 探针自己也被验了一次（照旧写进来）\n\n`abwalk.mjs` 第一版把 `--start` docs: the survival judge reads a residual, and a jump is a packet the server completes
Two source corrections and two status catch-ups, all from re-reading the
26.3 decompile rather than re-deriving from memory.

- moved-wrongly as used by handleMovePlayer (:1185-1203) tests the residual
  between the claimed position and what the server's own move achieved, not
  the stride size, and creative is exempt from the check entirely. The old
  inference in this file ("a 0.35/tick stride exceeds the threshold, survival
  would be setback") does not survive that reading. What survival actually
  changes (gravity, falling, landing, jump triggers) stays unmeasured, and
  P3 now starts with a survival walktest instead of an estimate.
- A jump is a claim the server completes: when a packet reports rising
  movement while airborne and the server sees the player on ground,
  handleMovePlayer calls jumpFromGround itself (:1175-1178). The trajectory
  is what is missing, not the action. Pillar-up similarly has its right-click
  half already (place clicks a neighbour block's face); creative flight is a
  product decision, not a technical gap, because creative sits outside the
  position check.
- setblock/fill/give all require LEVEL_GAMEMASTERS in 26.3, so running them
  means opping the fake player first -- the bypass proving itself. The M3
  blacklist keeps its permission line attached.
- The direction section still listed bridge_token and wait_for as upcoming;
  both shipped in 43591a3. What remains is the M5/M6 product acceptance
  criteria, then phase B: watch.mjs -> bugent.game.toml -> a human typing
  @buddy for acceptance.

fix: reached means the goal column, because a radius lied about a diagonal and one step read as no route
The reproducer was already on record: arrivetest from the stone pad showed all four
orthogonal neighbours refused as "pathfinder produced no route" and the (+1,+1)
diagonal claiming reached without moving. Two independent defects, both in where the
walk's finishes were measured, neither in the stride logic.

reachRange=1 hit the start node itself. PathFinder.findPath (:94) tests
current.distanceManhattan(target) <= reachRange, and a one-step orthogonal goal is
Manhattan 1, so A* returned a single-node path whose only node is the start; the
getNodeCount() <= 1 guard read that as "nothing to walk" and refused it. A diagonal
goal is Manhattan 2, so it sailed past the guard -- which is why only the orthogonals
were refused and only the diagonals could lie. Now reachRange=0: the path must end
exactly on the target node. Vanilla mobs pass 1 because a mob only needs to get near
things; a walk that promises arrival cannot.

Arrival was planar < 0.9 against the requested point, and arrivetest asks for integer
coordinates: floor(p)+1 is the near corner of the +1 cell, 0.707 from the stand
centre, inside the radius -> tick 1 reported reached with zero movement. The
minus-direction corner is 2.12 away, which is why only (+1,+1) lied. Arrival is now
the feet cell (BlockPos.containing) sharing x/z with the goal column.

The first cut of that made y strict equality, and walk 9 measured the counterexample:
a goal column holding short_grass stands the agent one above the requested y
(restHeight finds the plant as footing), so an exact stop at the point reported
stopped_short. The same shape was reproduced live after the fix: walk_to to the grass
cell (46,63,-51) from the mud beside it ends at (46.5, 64.0, -50.8) -- reached, feet
one above the request, the geometry the strict predicate failed. y within one step
inside the goal column is arrival; the column is what was asked for.

Measured after rebuild and restart, pad re-run first: arrivetest 6/6 ok,
false_reached 0; walktest -5 0 / 4 2 / -3 3 all reached at 15/14/13 ticks against
lower bounds 15/13/13, refused 0, degraded 0 everywhere. HANDOFF's unfixed section is
replaced with the fixed record and the live y-tolerance repro.

四条实测结论：

- **水平一步都不用改**。M2 那五个目标在生存下 tick 数与创造**逐条相同**（18/25/37/33/41），`refused/degraded=0/0`，`moved wrongly`/`too quickly`/setback/floating 全 0；1 格下降也 `reached`。昨晚那条"切生存必被 judged"的推断死了。
- **+1 台阶卡在我们自己的门上，不是服务端**。中间放一块石头再走上去 → 两模式都 `wedged`，`blocked_by=stone@44,77,-65`，停在差 0.4 格处。原因：`restHeight` 只看"目的地那一列"，而 0.35 的步幅永远落在低列，0.6 宽的身体却已伸进高列。而 `agent.claim` 实测：上升 1/2/6/10 **全部 accepted、residual 0**。原版自己也是 Y 优先解算（`Direction.axisStepOrder`）。另有一条：规划层也不爬（`back on` → `pathfinder produced no route`）——要修两处。
- **服务端不替我们飞**：跳跃触发确实响了（速度 0.42、离地标志 false，`:1176` 那条走通），但随后 25 次不声称地读，身体**冻在 +0.42**。弹道必须我们逐 tick 声称，这活躲不掉。单条位移上限约 10 格（12 格那条吃了 `moved too quickly`，预算是平方比 100）。
- **摔伤是我们自己发的那面旗决定的**：空中掉 9.8 而后落地不声称着地 → hp 不掉；同样序列落地那条发 `on_ground:true` → **hp 20→16**；创造同样声称不掉（invulnerable）。所以"如实模拟真人、疼就疼"落到实现上就是：如实发落地标志 + 把 hp 放进 walk 事件。80 tick 悬停红线**故意没实测**——踢下线了没有 respawn op，就得让你按键救 rig。

P3 顺序据此重排（比原估小）：① 修爬升的门（`restHeight` 按身体盒覆盖的列取高，允许"低列声称高 y"）② 弹道生成器（JUMP/FALL 逐 tick，跳跃首发诚实包，落地诚实发 ground 标志）③ 下降不限 1 格（`MAX_CHANGE` 是我们自己的保守值）④ 垫脚＝②+现有 place 的组合 ⑤ 不做悬停类特性。

已提交三点：`e6440d1` 两个 op、`5035814` 三个驱动（`abwalk` / `claimprobe` / `arcprobe`）、`69ae518` HANDOFF 事实表；agent 已切回创造、放回人类旁边。

152	   private static Vec3 standableSpotNear(final ServerLevel level, final Vec3 anchor, final int maxRadius) {
153	      BlockPos anchorPos = BlockPos.containing(anchor);
154	      for (int radius = 1; radius <= maxRadius; radius++) {
155	         for (int dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++) {
156	            for (int dz = -radius; dz <= radius; dz++) {
157	               if (Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dz)) != radius) {
158	                  continue;
159	               }
160	               // Down the column, not just beside it: the highest thing worth standing on is usually a
161	               // canopy, and the advisor treats leaves as blocked, so no route ever leaves the top of
162	               // one. Real ground is below it.
163	               for (int y = anchorPos.getY() + MAX_RISE; y >= anchorPos.getY() - MAX_DROP; y--) {
164	                  BlockPos feet = anchorPos.offset(dx, y - anchorPos.getY(), dz);
165	                  if (standable(level, feet)) {
166	                     return new Vec3(feet.getX() + 0.5, feet.getY(), feet.getZ() + 0.5);
167	                  }
168	               }
169	            }
170	         }
171	      }
172	      return null;
173	   }

177	    * two is a cage, and from a cage every claimed step collides, so the agent could never leave it no
178	    * matter how good the route was. The exit only needs air to move into - the drop or step up beyond
179	    * it is the server's to resolve, which is why a ledge counts as an exit and a wall does not.
180	    */
181	   private static boolean standable(final ServerLevel level, final BlockPos feet) {
182	      if (!roomFor(level, feet)) {
183	         return false;
184	      }
185	      int exits = 0;
186	      for (BlockPos side : new BlockPos[]{ feet.east(), feet.west(), feet.north(), feet.south() }) {
187	         if (clearAt(level, side)) {
188	            exits++;
189	         }
190	      }
191	      // Two, not one: a single open neighbour can be the only way out of a pocket, and the route the
192	      // advisor wants may point the other way. Measured: an agent with exactly one exit wedged with
193	      // refused=24 degraded=24 without moving a block, because every re-plan aimed at the wall.
194	      return exits >= 2;
195	   }

197	   private static boolean roomFor(final ServerLevel level, final BlockPos feet) {
198	      return clearAt(level, feet) && ground(level.getBlockState(feet.below()));
199	   }

204	    * no route ever leaves the top of one. Fluids are not a floor at all: they hold nothing up.
205	    */
206	   private static boolean ground(final BlockState below) {
207	      return !below.isAir() && !below.is(BlockTags.LEAVES) && !below.liquid();
208	   }

211	      return level.getBlockState(pos).isAir() && level.getBlockState(pos.above()).isAir();

270	      return out;

302	   /** The agent's connection is never registered with ServerConnectionListener, so nobody else drains it. */
303	   public static void tickIfAgent(final ServerPlayer self) {
304	      if (self != agent) {
305	         return;
306	      }
307	      ConnectionProbe.onAgentTick(self);
308	      EmbeddedChannel ownChannel = channel;
309	      if (self != agent || ownChannel == null) {
310	         return;
311	      }
312	      Object outbound;
313	      int dropped = 0;
314	      String headType = null;
315	      for (int budget = DRAIN_BUDGET; budget-- > 0 && (outbound = ownChannel.readOutbound()) != null; ) {
316	         if (headType == null) {
317	            headType = outbound.getClass().getName();
318	         }
319	         dropped++;
320	      }
321	      if (dropped > 0 && !queueShapeReported) {
322	         queueShapeReported = true;
323	         Mcbuddy.LOGGER.info(
324	               "[mcbuddy] outbound queue held {} message(s); head type = {} (teleport ack pending M2)",
325	               dropped,
326	               headType
327	            );
328	      }
329	   }

331	   /** Drives the agent the way vanilla drives real players: through its connection listener. */
332	   public static void tickAgentConnection() {
333	      ServerPlayer self = agent;
334	      if (self == null || self.isRemoved()) {
335	         return;
336	      }
337	      // tickConnection also runs while the server pumps events during its idle wait, so gate on the
338	      // tick counter: two position packets in one tick is a kick, and doTick must happen once.
339	      long tick = self.level().getServer().getTickCount();
340	      if (tick == lastDrivenTick) {
341	         return;
342	      }
343	      lastDrivenTick = tick;
344	      // Decays the say budget exactly once per tick, on the same gate the rest of the agent uses:
345	      // tickConnection also runs during the server's idle event pump, and double-decrementing would
346	      // silently widen the rate limit.
347	      sayRate.tick();
348	      answerKeepAlive(self);
349	      // Order matters: connection.tick() clears the per-tick "already received a position this tick"
350	      // flag inside tickPlayer/resetPosition, so a stride sent before it looks like a second packet.
351	      self.connection.tick();
352	      ackPendingTeleport(self);
353	      WalkTask.tick(self);
354	   }

356	   /**
357	    * A teleport the server sent stays latched until the client acks its id, and while it is latched
358	    * handleMovePlayer applies rotation only and drops the position (ServerGamePacketListenerImpl:1102).
359	    * Echo the awaited position back so the latch opens and our strides are honoured.
360	    */
361	   private static void ackPendingTeleport(final ServerPlayer self) {
362	      if (!(self.connection instanceof ServerGamePacketListenerImplTeleportAccessor accessor)) {
363	         return;
364	      }
365	      Vec3 awaited = accessor.mcbuddy$awaitingPositionFromClient();
366	      if (awaited == null) {
367	         return;
368	      }
369	      EmbeddedChannel own = channel;
370	      if (own != null) {
371	         Mcbuddy.LOGGER.info("[mcbuddy] acking teleport {} at {}", accessor.mcbuddy$awaitingTeleport(), awaited);
372	         own.writeInbound(
373	               new Object[]{
374	                     new ServerboundAcceptTeleportationPacket(
375	                           accessor.mcbuddy$awaitingTeleport(), awaited.x, awaited.y, awaited.z, self.getYRot(), self.getXRot()
376	                        )
377	                  }
378	            );
379	      }
380	   }

419	    * what actually changed, so a silent no-op shows up as one instead of being hidden by our own gate.

451	   /**
452	    * Right-click a neighbouring block's face so vanilla puts the held block into the target cell,
453	    * which is the only way a player can place anything: the hit is always on an existing block. We
454	    * choose which face to click, the server decides whether the placement happens
455	    * (ServerGamePacketListenerImpl:1408-1450 - reach, build limit, spawn protection, mayInteract).
456	    *
457	    * The report deliberately includes the two things that make this silently fail and are otherwise
458	    * invisible from outside: an empty hand, and a latched teleport (:1435 drops the whole interaction
459	    * while one is pending).
460	    */
461	   public static JsonObject placeAt(final BlockPos target) {
462	      return placeAt(target, null);
463	   }
464	
465	   public static JsonObject placeAt(final BlockPos target, final String bp) {
466	      JsonObject out = new JsonObject();
467	      ServerPlayer self = agent;
468	      if (self == null) {
469	         out.addProperty("placed", false);
470	         out.addProperty("reason", "no agent spawned");
471	         return out;
472	      }
473	      ServerLevel level = self.level();
474	      ItemStack held = self.getInventory().getSelectedItem();
475	      out.addProperty("held", describe(held));
476	      out.addProperty("teleport_latched", teleportLatched(self));
477	      if (held.isEmpty()) {
478	         out.addProperty("placed", false);
479	         out.addProperty("reason", "empty hand - agent.pick first");
480	         return out;
481	      }
482	      BlockPos support = null;
483	      Direction face = null;
484	      for (Direction towards : Direction.values()) {
485	         BlockPos candidate = target.relative(towards);
486	         if (!level.getBlockState(candidate).isAir()) {
487	            support = candidate;
488	            face = towards.getOpposite();
489	            break;
490	         }
491	      }
492	      if (support == null) {
493	         out.addProperty("placed", false);
494	         out.addProperty("reason", "no solid neighbour to click from");
495	         return out;
496	      }
497	      // Midpoint of the two cell centres is exactly the shared face, and sits 0.5 from the clicked
498	      // block's centre, inside the |distance| < 1.0000001 test at :1422.
499	      Vec3 hit = Vec3.atCenterOf(support).add(Vec3.atCenterOf(target)).scale(0.5);
500	      out.addProperty("support", blockId(level.getBlockState(support)));
501	      out.addProperty("within_reach", self.isWithinBlockInteractionRange(support, 1.0));
502	      String before = blockId(level.getBlockState(target));
503	      sendInbound(
504	            new ServerboundUseItemOnPacket(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND, new BlockHitResult(hit, face, support, false), nextSequence())
505	         );
506	      String after = blockId(level.getBlockState(target));
507	      out.addProperty("target_before", before);
508	      out.addProperty("target_after", after);
509	      out.addProperty("placed", !after.equals(before));
510	      if (!after.equals(before)) {
511	         // The blueprint records the transition the world accepted, not the cell the plan asked for, so
512	         // a placement that silently no-oped can never be "remembered" as built.
513	         EditLog.record(
514	               "place",
515	               target.getX(),
516	               target.getY(),
517	               target.getZ(),
518	               before,
519	               after,
520	               bp,
521	               level.getServer().getTickCount()
522	            );
523	      }
524	      Mcbuddy.LOGGER.info(
525	            "[mcbuddy] place into {} by clicking {} face {}: {} -> {} (latched={})",
526	            target,
527	            support,
528	            face,
529	            before,
530	            after,
531	            Boolean.valueOf(teleportLatched(self))
532	         );
533	      return out;
534	   }

539	    * restriction) and insta-mines in creative at :191 - so there is no crack progress until the
540	    * survival milestone, which is why that stays a separate piece of work.

546	   public static JsonObject breakAt(final BlockPos pos, final String bp) {

584	   /**
585	    * Where the agent would have to stand to touch this cell. Uses vanilla's own test rather than a
586	    * formula of our own: Player:1998-2001 compares the target AABB against the eye position with
587	    * blockInteractionRange() plus the 1.0 buffer every server caller passes, so the answer here cannot
588	    * drift from what the server will later accept. Candidates are searched outward from the target and
589	    * must satisfy the same standable rule used at spawn.
590	    */
591	   public static JsonObject standFor(final BlockPos target, final int maxRadius) {
592	      JsonObject out = new JsonObject();
593	      ServerPlayer self = agent;
594	      if (self == null) {
595	         out.addProperty("reachable", false);
596	         out.addProperty("reason", "no agent spawned");
597	         return out;
598	      }
599	      ServerLevel level = self.level();
600	      double eyeAboveFeet = self.getEyePosition().y - self.getY();
601	      double maxRange = self.blockInteractionRange() + 1.0;
602	      AABB box = new AABB(target);
603	      out.addProperty("range_blocks", maxRange);
604	      for (int radius = 1; radius <= maxRadius; radius++) {
605	         for (int dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++) {
606	            for (int dz = -radius; dz <= radius; dz++) {
607	               if (Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dz)) != radius) {
608	                  continue;
609	               }
610	               for (int dy : HEIGHT_TRIES) {
611	                  BlockPos candidate = target.offset(dx, dy, dz);
612	                  if (!standable(level, candidate)) {
613	                     continue;
614	                  }
615	                  Vec3 eye = new Vec3(candidate.getX() + 0.5, candidate.getY() + eyeAboveFeet, candidate.getZ() + 0.5);
616	                  if (box.distanceToSqr(eye) < maxRange * maxRange) {
617	                     out.addProperty("reachable", true);
618	                     out.addProperty("stand", describe(new Vec3(candidate.getX() + 0.5, candidate.getY(), candidate.getZ() + 0.5)));
619	                     out.addProperty("from_target_blocks", Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dz)));
620	                     return out;
621	                  }
622	               }
623	            }
624	         }
625	      }
626	      out.addProperty("reachable", false);
627	      out.addProperty("reason", "no standable cell within " + maxRadius + " of the target is in range");
628	      return out;
629	   }
630	
631	   /**
632	    * Rig operation, not a player action: put the agent on a specific spot so a test can start from
633	    * known ground. Gated by dev_writes, and it will not drop the agent into geometry - if the exact
634	    * cell is not standable it takes the nearest one that is and reports that it adjusted.
635	    */
636	   public static JsonObject teleportTo(final double x, final double y, final double z) {
637	      JsonObject out = new JsonObject();
638	      ServerPlayer self = agent;
639	      if (self == null) {
640	         out.addProperty("moved", false);
641	         out.addProperty("reason", "no agent spawned");
642	         return out;
643	      }
644	      if (!BuddyConfig.devWrites) {
645	         out.addProperty("moved", false);
646	         out.addProperty("reason", "dev_writes is off - this is a rig operation, not something the agent does");
647	         return out;
648	      }
649	      ServerLevel level = self.level();
650	      BlockPos wanted = BlockPos.containing(x, y, z);
651	      Vec3 spot;
652	      if (standable(level, wanted)) {
653	         spot = new Vec3(wanted.getX() + 0.5, wanted.getY(), wanted.getZ() + 0.5);
654	      } else {
655	         spot = standableSpotNear(level, new Vec3(wanted.getX() + 0.5, wanted.getY(), wanted.getZ() + 0.5), 3);
656	      }
657	      out.addProperty("from", describe(self.position()));
658	      if (spot == null) {
659	         out.addProperty("moved", false);
660	         out.addProperty("reason", "no standable cell at or within 3 of the requested spot");
661	         return out;
662	      }
663	      self.teleportTo(spot.x, spot.y, spot.z);
664	      out.addProperty("moved", true);
665	      out.addProperty("to", describe(spot));
666	      out.addProperty("adjusted", Boolean.valueOf(!describe(spot).equals(describe(new Vec3(wanted.getX() + 0.5, wanted.getY(), wanted.getZ() + 0.5)))));
667	      Mcbuddy.LOGGER.info("[mcbuddy] rig teleport {} -> {}", out.get("from"), describe(spot));
668	      return out;
669	   }

673	         && accessor.mcbuddy$awaitingPositionFromClient() != null;
